reasons.detail: R1 — `syncGitUrlSource` resolves and returns commit via `resolveGitUrlSourceCommit`, which uses `resolveRemoteDefaultCommit` (set-head + `origin/HEAD` + rev-parse) when `source.ref` is absent.
R2 — `resolveGitRefCommit` now deterministically resolves a specified ref after fetch using ordered candidates: remote branch, tag, then raw ref, with SHA fast-path and safe-ref validation.
R3 — New safety guards validate cache path under project `.senti/plugin-sources`, reject unsafe ids/symlinks/traversal, clean to target commit, and reclone on failed reset/clean repair.

R4 — `syncGitUrlSource` now yields resolved target commit; the updated sync flow is now deterministic and feedable to `update` callers, matching `previousCommit`/`commit` diff-based updated semantics in existing package-update logic.

R5 — Core public flows (`add/update/find/install`, preset resolution, config persistence, materialization, local-path dirty handling) are preserved in intent and are explicitly exercised by added tests while not being removed by the cache-sync changes.

R7 — Git URL path now ensures a committed, deterministic tree is produced before use (`cleanGitUrlSourceTree`, fallback reclone), so metadata/file readers in resolve/find/install flows can consume resolved target commit content.

R6 — Diff shows no addition of npm dependencies (no package/dependency file changes), and the new git-source logic uses runtime source IDs/URLs from config (`source.id`, `sourceLocation`) rather than hardcoded project-specific values.
